Role Purpose

The QA Engineer is responsible for ensuring product quality by testing web and mobile features, identifying bugs, validating requirements, and helping improve the release process to reduce production issues.

  • Experience testing Web, Mobile, API, and SaaS products

  • Familiar with bug tracking, root cause analysis, and release validation

  • Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail

  • Able to collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Engineering teams

  • Experience with Postman and API testing

  • Experience with Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or other automation frameworks is a plus

title: Senior/Lead Full-stack Software Engineer (React, Node.js) | EdTech | Dayshift
description_text: Do you have a sharp eye for breaking down complex problems & an innate gift for writing elegant code? How does working in an environment that truly cares about your growth (without milking you dry) sound to you? [About Our Team] At The Pique Lab, we’re on a mission to create the best Math & Science learning experience for students aged 9 to 16 in Singapore. Our lessons are meticulously crafted based on pedagogical research and data-driven methodologies to achieve one overarching goal: to make learning fun, shorten learning curves and help students develop a genuine appreciation for Math & Science . Over the past decade, we've grown from a pair of co-founders to a diverse team of over 100 team members across 10 departments. Our proprietary learning methodology and examination-centric materials have helped more than 20,000 students ace their examinations. Our headquarters is in Singapore, with remote teams in China, India, Malaysia and the Philippines. We take pride in our open, fast-paced and flat organisational structure where every team member is valued for their skills and competencies, not just their job titles. If you want to spend your time meaningfully on cool edtech projects & NOT refactoring buggy, legacy code, you might be the next teammate we’re looking for! [What’s In It For You To Join Us?] Working Arrangement : Remote (Note: As our operational needs may evolve, we are looking for someone who is comfortable with potential office setup arrangements, including the possibility of working from our onsite offices in Jakarta or Batam.) Working Hours : Monday to Friday, 10AM to 7PM (inclusive of 1-hour lunch break) (Singapore Timezone) Team Size : 15 (Software Engineers, UI/UX Designers, Product Managers) Projects (assigned depending on your skills, interest & business needs): School Management System (ERP/Web & Mobile, iOS/Android) + Cloud Contact Centre (Web) [Our Technology] We work with a lot of exciting technology: React, Typescript, SASS, Redux for frontend work. Node.js, GraphQL for our service code. MongoDB, ElasticSearch for storage & indexing. LLMs & Langchain for GenAI functionalities. Kubernetes, Docker & Github Actions for continuous integration & delivery. Google Cloud for underlying infrastructure. Puppeteer, Playwright & Selenium for testing. GitHub Copilot & Cursor IDE for AI code assistance. [Your Role & Growth] We’re positioning ourselves as an AI-first engineering team . We’re actively experimenting with modern AI tools to enhance how our developers build, test, and ship code. From automated code reviews to generative workflows, we’re laying the groundwork to integrate AI meaningfully into our engineering processes. You will use the power of code to solve complex business problems, so that our users can focus their time & energy on things that matter . You’ll join us at a pivotal movement where we scale rapidly & this means you’ll get more opportunities when you embark on this journey with us. #1: Spearhead Hands-on Development From breaking down complex problems to designing solutions that are easy-to-maintain, flexible & scalable , this role is perfect for tech enthusiasts who appreciate diversity in their role. You'll spend the bulk of your time developing, testing & deploying dynamic web-based solutions . Growing your career with us is a marathon, not a sprint. We know what we want from our software engineering team & are careful not to spread our team members too thin. #2: Work With The Latest Tech Tools We invest in the latest tech tools to help us become more efficient & productive at our work, so we can focus on higher-value activities instead of pencil-pushing tasks. Our headquarters is in Singapore, with remote teams in China, India, Malaysia and the Philippines. We take pride in our open, fast-paced and flat organisational structure where every team member is valued for their skills and competencies, not just their job titles.

If you want to spend your time meaningfully on cool edtech projects & NOT refactoring buggy, legacy code, you might be the next teammate we’re looking for!

title: Application Migration Engineer
description_text: Responsibilities: 1. Validation & Cutover • Testing: Perform UAT (User Acceptance Testing) and performance benchmarking to ensure the application performs better in AWS than its source environment. • Cutover Management: Execute final data syncs and DNS switchovers (using Route 53) with minimal downtime. • Post-Migration Support: Provide "Hypercare" support during the first 30 days post-migration to tune performance

This position will be responsible for designing, building, and deploying advanced artificial intelligence solutions that enhance products, services, and internal processes across the organization. Key Responsibilities: Design, develop, and train machine learning and deep learning models. Experiment with different model architectures to enhance performance. Integrate AI models into existing systems and applications. Deploy and maintain models in production environments. Optimize models for speed, scalability, and cost-efficiency. Research and explore new techniques for optimizing Large Language Models (LLMs). Collaborate with data engineers, software engineers, product managers, and other teams. Clearly communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Define project requirements and deliverables with cross-functional teams. Monitor and improve model performance using feedback and new data. Document the development process, models, and algorithms. Prepare reports and presentations on project progress and outcomes. Requirements: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field. Min 5 years Proven experience in machine learning, deep learning, and AI model development. Hands-on experience with AI frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch. Proficiency in Python; experience in Java, GoLang, or Node.js is a plus. Experience with training and deploying Large Language Models (e.g., GPT, LLAMA). Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

PT Tuntun Sekuritas Indonesia is looking for candidates to fill AI Engineer role. This position will be responsible for designing, building, and deploying advanced artificial intelligence solutions that enhance products, services, and internal processes across the organization.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Design, develop, and train machine learning and deep learning models.

  2. Experiment with different model architectures to enhance performance.

  3. Integrate AI models into existing systems and applications.

  4. Deploy and maintain models in production environments.

  5. Optimize models for speed, scalability, and cost-efficiency.

  6. Research and explore new techniques for optimizing Large Language Models (LLMs).

  7. Collaborate with data engineers, software engineers, product managers, and other teams.

  8. Clearly communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

  9. Define project requirements and deliverables with cross-functional teams.

  10. Monitor and improve model performance using feedback and new data.

  11. Document the development process, models, and algorithms.

  12. Prepare reports and presentations on project progress and outcomes.

Requirements:

  1. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.

  2. Min 5 years Proven experience in machine learning, deep learning, and AI model development.

  3. Hands-on experience with AI frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch.

  4. Proficiency in Python; experience in Java, GoLang, or Node.js is a plus.

  5. Experience with training and deploying Large Language Models (e.g., GPT, LLAMA).

  6. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

title: IT Capacity Planner
description_text: Job Description : Ensure IT infrastructure resources (hardware, software, network, and cloud services) have sufficient capacity to support current and future business needs. Monitor, analyze, and optimize system performance, utilization, and scalability across enterprise environments. Conduct capacity forecasting and performance modeling to anticipate infrastructure growth and prevent bottlenecks. Provide recommendations for resource optimization and cost efficiency, including cloud and FinOps-related initiatives. Support performance testing, monitoring implementation, and continuous improvement of system observability practices. Familiarity with performance testing tools such as JMeter and Gatling is considered a plus. Strong analytical thinking, structured problem-solving abilities, and attention to detail.

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Kami mencari Project Engineer yang bertanggung jawab mengeksekusi proyek instalasi lighting dari kick-off hingga handover kepada klien. Anda akan bekerja langsung di lapangan, memimpin tim teknisi, memastikan instalasi berjalan sesuai desain, tepat waktu, dan sesuai standar keselamatan.


Tanggung Jawab

  1. Perencanaan & Koordinasi Proyek:

  • Mempelajari desain dan lighting plot dari tim Pre-Sales Engineer sebelum eksekusi

  • Membuat jadwal instalasi, alokasi material, dan koordinasi tim teknisi lapangan

  • Berkoordinasi dengan klien/owner venue terkait akses lokasi, jadwal, dan kebutuhan teknis

  • Menyiapkan checklist material, tools, dan perlengkapan keselamatan sebelum mobilisasi ke site

  1. Instalasi & Commissioning:

  • Memimpin dan mengawasi pemasangan fixture lighting (moving head, effect light, laser, PAR, dll.)

  • Mengawasi pemasangan truss, rigging, dan struktur penggantung sesuai standar keselamatan

  • Melakukan instalasi wiring DMX, power distribution (PDU), dan sistem kontrol

  • Bekerja sama dengan DMX Programmer dalam proses patching, addressing, dan commissioning

  • Melakukan testing dan troubleshooting sistem lighting sebelum handover

  • Memastikan seluruh instalasi sesuai dengan desain, spesifikasi, dan standar yang telah disepakati

  1. Dokumentasi & Pelaporan:

  • Membuat as-built drawing dan dokumentasi instalasi yang akurat

  • Menyusun berita acara serah terima (BAST) kepada klien

  • Melaporkan progress harian/mingguan kepada Project Manager atau manajemen

  • Mendokumentasikan setiap perubahan (change order) yang terjadi di lapangan

  1. Quality & Safety:

  • Memastikan seluruh proses instalasi memenuhi standar keselamatan kerja (K3)

  • Melakukan inspeksi kualitas pemasangan sebelum commissioning

  • Mengidentifikasi dan melaporkan potensi risiko atau hambatan proyek secara proaktif


Persyaratan

  1. Kualifikasi Wajib

  • Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 Teknik Elektro, Teknik Mesin, atau bidang terkait

  • Minimal 2 tahun pengalaman di bidang instalasi stage lighting, AV systems, electrical installation, atau proyek MEP

  • Memahami konsep DMX512, moving head fixture, LED lighting, dan power distribution

  • Mampu membaca technical drawing, lighting plot, dan diagram satu line

  • Familiar dengan rigging, truss system, dan standar keselamatan pemasangan di ketinggian

  • Bersedia melakukan perjalanan dinas ke seluruh Indonesia sesuai kebutuhan proyek

  • Memiliki SIM A aktif

  1. Kualifikasi Tambahan (Nilai Plus)

  • Pengalaman menggunakan lighting console: grandMA2/3, Avolites, ChamSys untuk commissioning dasar

  • Memiliki sertifikasi K3 Umum atau K3 Listrik

  • Pengalaman memimpin tim teknisi di lapangan

  • Familiar dengan software project management (MS Project, Trello, atau sejenisnya)

  • Pengalaman proyek nightclub, concert hall, livehouse, atau house of worship


Kompetensi yang Dibutuhkan

  • Leadership — mampu memimpin dan mengkoordinasikan tim teknisi di lapangan

  • Problem-solving — cepat tanggap terhadap masalah teknis di site

  • Detail-oriented — teliti dalam instalasi, pengkabelan, dan dokumentasi

  • Komunikatif — mampu berkoordinasi dengan klien, tim internal, dan subkontraktor

  • Adaptif — siap bekerja dengan jadwal fleksibel dan kondisi lapangan yang dinamis

  • Fisik prima — mampu bekerja di ketinggian dan kondisi lapangan selama proyek berlangsung

title: Sound Engineering
description_text: A Sound Engineer manages the technical and creative aspects of sound production, recording, mixing, and mastering audio for music, film, live events, or broadcast . They set up microphones, operate mixing consoles, adjust audio levels, and apply effects to achieve high-quality, balanced audio while troubleshooting equipment in real-time. Core Responsibilities Audio Setup & Maintenance: Setting up, testing, and maintaining microphones, speakers, cables, and mixing desks for studio recording or live performances. Recording & Mixing: Recording instruments and vocals onto separate tracks, adjusting volume levels, and balancing sound elements for a clean, cohesive mix. Post-Production: Editing and mastering audio tracks using software (DAWs) to refine sound quality for final distribution. Live Sound Operation: Conducting soundchecks and managing front-of-house or monitor mixing to ensure high-quality sound for live audiences and performers. Collaboration: Working with directors, producers, and artists to understand their creative vision and delivering technical input to improve sound quality. Troubleshooting: Identifying and fixing technical audio issues on-site or in the studio.

Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. Job Description

Get to Know the Team

The Fulfilment tech family enables Grab to serve our customers and partners across Southeast Asia. We build high throughput, real-time distributed systems that process hundreds of millions of requests daily.

Our mission is to offer the best products and experiences to our driver partners. We improve driver partner opportunities and efficiency to fulfil customer orders without fail. We create efficient marketplaces by determining prices that are both sustainable and valued by our partners and customers.

Get to Know the Role

You will join our team in Jakarta as a Mobile (iOS) Software Engineer. You will build iOS features used by driver partners across the region, including communication experiences, AI-assisted workflows, and offline-first screens that remain reliable in real-world operating conditions.

You will work with product managers, designers, backend engineers, data analysts, and other mobile engineers to build features for the Grab driver app. You will report to the Software Engineering Manager and based fully on-site in Jakarta office.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

  • You will develop iOS features using Swift for driver communication, AI-assisted workflows, and offline-first screens that handle unstable network conditions.
  • You will integrate iOS applications with backend APIs and mobile platform components to deliver reliable user experiences.
  • You will collaborate with product managers, designers, and backend engineers to understand requirements and evaluate product impact through data analysis.
  • You will write testable code following established engineering standards and participate in code reviews to maintain product quality.
  • You will resolve issues related to app performance, reliability, and offline behavior through debugging and testing.
  • You will contribute to app stability through unit testing, integration testing, and validation of features before release.

Qualifications

What Essential Skills You Will Need

  • Up to 2 years of professional iOS development experience, internship experience, or project experience building iOS applications using Swift and the iOS SDK. You will use Swift daily to build features for the driver app.
  • Understanding of mobile application architecture patterns (MVC, MVVM, VIPER, or similar). You will apply these patterns to structure code for features that communicate with AI systems and handle offline scenarios.
  • Working knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented programming. You will use these to write efficient code for processing hundreds of millions of requests and to solve technical problems during feature development.
  • Experience integrating mobile applications with RESTful APIs or backend services. You will connect iOS features to backend systems that power driver communication and AI-assisted workflows.
  • Experience using AI agent-assisted coding tools and spec-driven development workflows to design, implement, and validate software changes. You will use these tools to build features more efficiently and maintain code quality.
  • Experience with unit testing or integration testing for iOS applications. You will write tests to ensure features work correctly, especially for offline functionality and network-resilient components.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience building offline-capable or network-resilient mobile features.
  • Familiarity with mobile storage technologies such as Core Data, SQLite, Realm, or similar.
  • Experience with unit testing, UI testing, or automated testing in iOS.
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, release processes, or mobile observability tools.
  • Interest in AI, LLM-powered applications, chatbots, or conversational product experiences.
  • Experience with GraphQL, WebSocket, gRPC, or real-time communication features.
  • Familiarity with large-scale mobile applications or modular mobile architectures.
  • Experience working in cross-functional or regional teams.

Additional Information

Life at Grab

We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:

  • We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
  • With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
  • Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
  • We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
  • Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

What We Stand For At Grab

We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that provides equal opportunity for Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. We consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, race, religion, age, gender, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

Bersedia ditugaskan ke lokasi proyek dan nyaman dengan kondisi lapangan (termasuk tugas yang membutuhkan ketelitian dan daya tahan fisik). Bersedia bekerja shift malam atau mengunjungi lokasi proyek sesuai kebutuhan pengawasan proyek. Menguasai software autocad, dapat mengambar diagram wiring.

It operates in more than 170 countries with a global workforce of over 207,000. The company’s excellence is consistently recognized worldwide, ranking as a Top 10 Global Employer. The company continues to lead the industry in R&D investment, focusing on building a fully connected, intelligent world while prioritizing "Tech for a Better Planet." This global commitment includes a heavy emphasis on Green ICT, driving the shift toward sustainable digital power technologies and innovative solar energy solutions to significantly reduce global carbon footprints. Proactively organize product engineers to address customer business pain points and provide rapid, effective solutions. Issue Handling & Coordination: Navigate complex issue-handling processes, leading cross-functional efforts across various product domains to ensure quick and successful resolution of technical challenges. Certifications: High-level professional certifications such as HCIE or CCIE are highly preferred. Experience Experienced Engineer who has been in Solution Delivery roles for at least 5 years, within the ICT or ISP industry. Product & Technical Expertise Technical Architecture: Proven capability in designing technical solution architectures and a track record of delivering high-stakes, key projects. Domain Expertise: Hands-on and direct experience with IP RAN solutions for backbone networks, SDN for data centers, and WLAN, SD-WAN, and Firewall products for campus environments as crucial components in Fixed Wireless Access. Protocol Proficiency: Professional proficiency in core technologies, including MPLS, SRv6, VXLAN, and NCE-x. Professional Qualities Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively under pressure (stress resistance). Experience in team management and leading technical experts, demonstrating seniority and technical maturity. Strong analytical mindset, solution-driven, collaborative, and adaptive to a fast-paced environment. Language Skills Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken.

title: Production Engineer
description_text: Production Engineer We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Production Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in optimizing and improving our manufacturing or operational processes to enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and ensure quality. You will be responsible for identifying opportunities for process improvements, designing solutions, and implementing them in a collaborative and dynamic environment. This position requires a combination if technical expertise, problem solving skills and BOM management. Responsibility: Data Analysis: collect and analyze process data to identify trends, discrepancies, and areas for improvement using statistical tools and methodologies. Process Optimization: identify, analyze, and implement process improvements across the production lifecycle to increase efficiency, reduce waste, and enhance product quality. Project Management, lead and manage process improvement projects from concept through execution, ensuring timely delivery, cost-effectiveness, and alignment with business goals. Cross-Functional Collaboration, work closely with cross-functional teams including production, quality, R&D, and maintenance to align process improvements with company objectives. Troubleshooting & Problem-Solving to provide technical expertise to troubleshoot process issues. Documentation & reporting to maintain detailed records of process changes, improvements, and project status. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in chemical, mechanical, industrial Engineering, or related field, with minimum 3 years of experience in the same position. This position requires a combination if technical expertise, problem solving skills and BOM management. Proficient in process simulation software, statistical analysis tools, and industry-specific tools (e.g., Statistical Process Control (SPC), FMEA, DOE, 8D Problem Solving, DMAIC etc.). Strong analytical and Root cause analysis skills, with the ability to think critically and solve complex engineering problems. Provide technical expertise to troubleshoot process issues, resolve operational problems, and implement corrective actions as needed. Ability to perform under high pressure, result oriented and good trouble shooting capability. Fluent in English reading, speaking and written, solid skill for Microsoft office. Good attitude, adaptability to company culture, teamwork spirit and influence skills, problem solving skills, able to handle multi-task and seek continuous improvement, active listening, presentation skills.
